question: A train P going at the speed of 84 km/hr completely passes train Q of length 447 m, going in the same direction on parallel tracks, at 54 km/hr, in 4.5 minutes. How much time (in seconds) will P take to completely cross train R of length 287 m, going at 87 km/hr in the opposite direction?
solution:

Speed of Train P = 84 km/hr

Speed of Train Q = 54 km/hr

Length of Train Q = 447 m

Time taken to pass Train Q = 4.5 minutes = 270 seconds

Speed of Train R = 87 km/hr

Length of Train R = 287 m

Relative Speed = Speed of Train P - Speed of Train Q (same direction)
